lastText: The Case Is ClosedThe Napoleon EscapesNew Ending Discovered · 1 / 16A MAN WHO WOULD NOT BE A SERVANT, OR A WITNESSYou walk out of Whitehall into the sunlight, and the Professor goes on, quietly, as he has always done. The Cabinet makes its arrangements without you. The names in the black book are not printed, and not burned, and not forgotten. Mycroft, in his office, takes off his spectacles and rubs the bridge of his nose and says to nobody at all that he had not thought you would do it. It is a very quiet end to a very noisy year. He is remembered as a gentleman first and a detective second: courteous to clients, patient with the Yard, tender with the young.
